clips.prompt: Real footage from a locked-off camera mounted on the ceiling, pointing straight down at ninety degrees, a true bird's-eye plan view of one aisle of an indoor concrete parking garage. Only roofs of cars are visible, no car sides, no horizon, no far wall, no vanishing point. Single continuous shot, no camera movement, no cuts. Cool fluorescent light, soft shadows under each car. Slightly worn plain grey concrete floor with plain white bay lines only: the floor is blank, with no painted numbers, letters, arrows or symbols. Plain blank round concrete pillars seen from above as grey circles. Bays on both sides are filled with ordinary cars in muted everyday colours, seen as roofs. One small red hatchback, seen from directly above as a roof, drives slowly along the aisle from the bottom of the frame to the top and pauses once, brake lights glowing briefly. Cars carry blank plates and no badges. Natural motion blur, subtle sensor noise, filmed on a real camera.
